title: It’s just okay
text: It’s just okay. I have another laundry hamper similar to this that looks the same but is heavier and sturdier. This one is okay but surprisingly flimsy feeling. The fabric is thinner and the bamboo bracing is too. The interior divider is a thin piece of fabric and plastic you manually place inside and tie in all 4 corners. It’s cheap and flimsy too. The lid is held onto basket with fabric, not hinges. It doesn’t have a magnet closure so it just rests on top. I think it looks better than a laundry basket, but on closer inspection isn’t very well made.
